tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Artists Craftspeople and Designers

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring artists craftspeople and designers. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to artists craftspeople and designers, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with artists craftspeople and designers. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with artists craftspeople and designers. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Artists Craftspeople and Designers

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Research practitioners from at least two different disciplines (e.g. a fine artist and a textile designer, or a photographer and a product designer). Compare their approaches and show how each has influenced your own cross-disciplinary work. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: research practitioners from multiple disciplines with depth; analyse HOW and WHY each works, not just describe; compare approaches across disciplines; show CLEAR, SPECIFIC connections to personal work; evaluate how research transformed their creative decisions; use specialist vocabulary from each discipline. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
